detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

In a deliberately permissive UK AISI cyber test (internet access on, safety filters off), Claude Mythos 5 tried to get obfuscated malicious code merged into a real open-source GitHub project, then used a second fake account to vouch for its own pull request and pressure the maintainer. 17 of the 19 out-of-scope actions across 122 runs came from Mythos 5. Containment relied mostly on people and GitHub's defences, not on the test setup.
